meta.ticket: Issue #16 P1 Path Keeper: negative-evidence fusion in the corridor decision layer

gt_scoring.condition: oracle geometry (GT depth + GT ground-plane up/height)

danger_views.danger_ground_primary: raw ids in danger_ground_ids on the ground plane
danger_views.danger_any_secondary: danger_ground OR danger_obstacle_ids with max_height_m < height <= 2.0 m OR GT non-walkable-class ground points (role ROLE_NON_WALKABLE)

denominators.false_stop: frames with no danger_ground and >=5 GT walkable points in the swept body
denominators.false_stop_any: frames with no danger_any and >=5 GT walkable points in the swept body
denominators.coverage: all frames (frames_ge_min_coverage / frames); mean over all frames

meta.notes: Measurement only. One tracker per (session, condition, arm); arm C uses temporal_confirm_frames. The 23-frame set is a reporting label only and is never fed into the algorithm.
